payload.description: Reproduced failure across 2 executions with identical context.
payload.action: Review Loop iteration 1 finding detected: FIND-R1-001-01
symptoms: A `git worktree add` killed before git writes the new worktree's HEAD leaves a `locked initializing` registration that `git worktree remove --force --force` rejects (exit 128) while its directory exists; the sweep then deletes the directory and prune skips the locked entry, so the next step leaves it registered and only the step after clears it (reproduced with a real kill). Repeat the removal after the delete when the first one failed, and add a test.
